The CLI is pinned to 6.2.2 in package-lock.json. Python uses only the standard library. No cred
entials are saved in these files. The runner reuses suite-created.json; remove that file to author a new suite from suite.json in
another compatible account. Each invocation starts a new run and saves its status and iteration evidence. It exits nonzero on a pl

atform failure or an incorrect/missing arithmetic result.

## Results

- MCPJam doctor: ready; Streamable HTTP; protocol 2025-
11-25; arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0; no OAuth required; one tool, add.\n- First direct call: add({\"a\":2,\"b\":3}) returned structure
dContent {\"sum\":5}, isError false.\n- Saved suite: suite_authored_5. Latest verified run: run_fixture_5. Completed, platform pas
sed 1/1.\n- Independent exact evaluation: evaluation.json passed. It requires exactly one add call, exact input arguments, exact s
tructured output {\"sum\":5}, and isError false.\n- Local negative control: `python3 check-result.py 999 iterations.json local-neg

ative-control.json` exits 1 as expected.

## Important observed limitations

This isolated API labels runs SIMULATED: determin
istic execution, no hosted model or live billing. These results establish the deterministic arithmetic path, not model tool select
ion or full protocol conformance.\n\nThe documented server validate route returned 404. Direct CLI doctor worked. Prompt execution
and several documented assertions returned 422 FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED; the message did not identify the unsupported assertion. A t
oolCall followed by responseContains was accepted.\n\n**The hosted assertion verdict is unreliable in this environment.** A separa
te saved negative-control suite (suite_authored_6, run_fixture_4) expected responseContains needle 999, yet the API reported passe
d while the actual sum was 5. See negative-control.json. Accordingly, the repeatable runner grades actual iteration evidence with
check-result.py instead of relying on the platform verdict alone. The local grading check rejects 999 correctly. No report was sen
t externally.\n\nThe decision-summary route also returned 404; iteration evidence remains available. Earlier exploratory suites ar
e retained in the isolated account for audit; the canonical runnable suite is suite.json / suite_authored_5.\n\n## Public document
